one_line: DOJ/USSS four-count indictment of e-gold Ltd + Gold & Silver Reserve + principals (Jackson brothers, Downey) for money laundering + unlicensed money transmitting; unsealed 2007-04-27; the seminal digital-currency enforcement action, predating the 2008 guilty plea already in corpus (egold-doj-guilty-plea-2008-07).

Liberty Reserve founder Arthur Budovsky sentenced to 20 years in Manhattan federal court for laundering hundreds of millions; completes the 2013 takedown arc (companion to liberty-reserve-coordinated-takedown-2013-05, authored tick 1).

Payment processor Dwolla cut off TradeHill (early US Bitcoin exchange) citing compliance/FinCEN pressure, freezing funds and killing the exchange (TradeHill later sued Dwolla). Early financial-rail debanking of a crypto exchange. tier=discovery_only_2008_2012. AUTHORED as events/tradehill-dwolla-payment-cutoff-2012-02.yaml (tick 3).
Capital One closed BitFloor (NY Bitcoin exchange) bank account, part of the 2013 banking de-risking / Operation-Choke-Point-era wave that debanked crypto exchanges. Financial-rail censorship.

CFPB consumer advisory warning about virtual-currency risks. BORDERLINE SCOPE: a warning/advisory, not a block or enforcement action — review whether soft regulatory-posture markers belong in the censorship census (likely a null/context row at best).

Cryptsy exchange collapse/insolvency (CEO "Big Vern" allegedly stole millions; court receiver). LIKELY OUT OF SCOPE: a fraud/theft/insolvency, NOT a censorship action — flagging for scope decision (exchange failures != censorship unless state-driven).

Mt.Gox Chapter 15 US bankruptcy recognition (Dallas), recognizing the Japanese insolvency. BORDERLINE: bankruptcy recognition, not a censorship action; corpus already has Mt.Gox bankruptcy/seizure events. Likely a related-event cross-ref, not a standalone censorship row.

FATF Updated Risk-Based-Approach Guidance for VAs/VASPs (Travel Rule operationalization). CENSORSHIP-ENABLING: mandates VASP originator/beneficiary data-sharing -> de-anonymization + transaction-blocking downstream.
Basel Committee final cryptoasset prudential standard (SCO60), 1250% risk weight on Group-2 cryptoassets. DE-RISKING-ENABLING: punitive capital rules push banks to debank crypto.
IOSCO 18 policy recommendations for crypto/digital-asset markets. SOFT-GOVERNANCE (recommendations, not a block) -> likely context-only per scope-boundary question.
FSB final high-level recommendations for global stablecoin arrangements. SOFT-GOVERNANCE -> context-only candidate.
EU ESAs (EBA/ESMA/EIOPA) joint consumer warning on virtual-currency risks (2013-12). SOFT-WARNING (like CFPB 2014) -> context-only per scope-boundary.

EU 8th Russia sanctions package: total ban on providing crypto-asset wallet/account/custody services to Russian persons (tightening the earlier cap). DIRECT CENSORSHIP at offramp_cex/asset layer. NOTE: verify exact package/date (8th=2022-10; later 18th/19th/20th expanded) before authoring.
OFAC designated Genesis Market (major stolen-credential darknet marketplace) alongside the international Operation Cookie Monster takedown. Treasury jy2616.
OFAC designated Russian crypto services Netex24 + Bitpapa for sanctions-evasion facilitation. Treasury jy2204.
OFAC (US/UK/AU) designated Russia-based Evil Corp ransomware group members; updated designation tying Evil Corp to LockBit. Treasury jy2623.
OFAC designated Russian neo-Nazi paramilitary group Task Force Rusich (crowdfunding the Ukraine war via crypto). One of the early terror/paramilitary crypto-address designations.
First OFAC designation of a crypto-MINING company (BitRiver AG + 10 RU subsidiaries). AUTHORED as events/bitriver-russia-mining-ofac-2022-04.yaml (tick 5).

SEC charged Zachary Coburn (EtherDelta founder) for operating an unregistered securities exchange — the FIRST SEC enforcement against a decentralized exchange (DEX) operator. ENFORCEMENT-CENSORSHIP (state action against a DEX frontend/operator).
SEC sued LBRY for unregistered securities (LBC); the case ultimately forced LBRY to wind down operations (2023). ENFORCEMENT-CENSORSHIP (state action killed a decentralized content protocol).
SEC won summary judgment vs Kik Interactive over the $100M Kin token ICO (unregistered offering); Kik settled $5M. ENFORCEMENT (token-offering crackdown).

DOJ/FBI seized ~$2.3M (63.7 BTC) of the Colonial Pipeline ransom paid to DarkSide, recovering the private key. ASSET-ONCHAIN SEIZURE — high-profile. AUTHORING NOTE: asset_onchain observed_change needs a primary_onchain tx_hash (the seizure tx); locate it before authoring (codebook 1.6).

DOJ SDNY charged OneCoin leaders (Konstantin Ignatov; Ruja Ignatova at large) in the multi-billion-dollar OneCoin Ponzi. BORDERLINE/OUT-OF-SCOPE: prosecuting a SCAM, not censoring a legit crypto service (cf. scope-boundary flag).

SEC 21(a) DAO Report — established that tokens can be securities (declined to prosecute). REGULATORY-REPORT (foundational framework, not an enforcement/block action) -> soft/context-only per scope-boundary.

Bittrex delisted privacy coins Monero (XMR), Zcash (ZEC), Dash (DASH) effective 2021-01-15, citing regulatory/compliance. offramp_cex observed_change. AUTHOR-READY (privacy-delisting template exists: kraken-monero-eu-delisting-2024).

Tether froze ~$28M USDT in Garantex-linked wallets after the EU sanctioned Garantex, effectively halting the exchange. Clear asset_onchain issuer freeze + offramp shutdown. Tether announced a policy to voluntarily freeze wallets of all OFAC-SDN-listed persons. CENSORSHIP-POLICY (issuer-level freeze capability extension) rather than a single action — review whether policy announcements are events or context.

Bittrex Global wound down / ceased trading (Dec 2023) following the US Bittrex Chapter 11 + SEC unregistered-exchange suit. Borderline: shutdown partly enforcement-driven (SEC) vs business decision — tag for scope.
